author: Claude
engine_base_commit: 9ed4117 (patch_raw_decoder), trial code applied locally and reverted, never committed
corpus: tests/image/base, neutral render in memory (iprRenderServer), full definition, Camera Neutral, optics off

measure.space: rendered sRGB 16-bit divided by 257 (8-bit scale, float)
measure.dark_mask: luma Rec.709 < 25, computed PER STATE (not a fixed mask shared across states)
measure.fields: dark share, mean luma of dark pixels, share of channels < 0.5/255 in dark pixels, mean R-G and B-G of dark pixels
measure.caveat: the share of channels at 0 does not prove a clip: in such dark pixels 0/255 is plain black

trials.name: D-grey at DCP table input
trials.rule: pixel with a ProPhoto channel < 0 moved toward the grey of its ProPhoto Y until min = 0; grey (Y,Y,Y) if Y <= 0; only with signed development
trials.result: no visible change on 7Y6A7599 B-col100 (crops n3_dgrey); hypothesis that table-input clipping makes the pink grain rejected

trials.name: D1+D2 (part below 0 around HSV tables, then tone curve first-segment slope)
trials.rule: server option only; not separated into D1 and D2
trials.dark_pixels_note: mean luma of dark pixels [without, with] the trial

trials.name: sRGB output mapping with signed luminance
trials.rule: mapRgbToSrgbGamut without the per-channel max(0) pre-clamp: signed luminance kept, chroma scaled toward it, black if luminance <= 0

conclusion: D0 kept; the pink residual grain of B-col100 on 7599 is not explained by the tested bounds; to be judged visually by the user
